source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924, p. 5 ("Local boards: nominations for the June elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: names and divisions read on the OCR of the News-Letter's nomination list of 8 May 1924

note: Nomination-day report for the eighteen electoral divisions of Newtownards (North Down) rural district, one member each. Seventeen candidates were returned unopposed. Ballymaglaff was the only division with two nominations, Joseph Berkely and William Robert Morrow; the result of that contest was not traced. Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
